comments.text:
I appreciate the recommendation on taking breaks. It's easy to let it eat up your time. I've learned that once you start spending most of your gaming time staring at your backlog or hunting for deals, then it's time for a break. I'm trying to get back to a point where I'm genuinely excited to buy a game and immediately play it, rather than throwing it into the backlog with all the other games I got on sale that I'll probably never touch. 

It blows my mind that we are at an age where we need to figure out how to manage the abundance of entertainment at our fingertips. Evolutionarily speaking these moments of relaxation were farther in between as we concerned ourselves with survival, and now here we are. Kind of like food and dieting I guess. Spend the last thousands of generations scrounging and prepping for the winters, rationing when needed, and now we're paying money to figure out how not to eat too much. What a time to be alive.
comments.author: @Shoeshooshu
